content: ʼInega wese taha tovaleʼewa yaʼitea mahalega webuwebui mai. Tauna me ena luvine qiduana, ta wese ena simatalega bwaʼobwaʼo qabuna guvesimatalia.

content.text: be bwavubwavudi ana ʼoine ʼinega niʼa inuma.
mana ʼabaga nana kavona tokodada taha ʼidewani.
Ta ʼabaga nana ena vekaikaiwabu ʼinega

content: ʼInega mahalega wese taha bona yanoqolia vonaya,

content.text: ona ʼifoqe fole ena luveifana navaukamana ʼimia
be ana luvematasabu luveifa nana weaqina
Mana ʼabaga nana ena luveifana veagovi vaneqa
ta ena ilivu luveifadi Yaubada ge danuafania.”
e omiʼa wese ʼedewana ona veʼia ʼaiqea,
ta ʼeguma tauna taha yani niʼa viaqia ʼimia,
e ʼinega ana veʼia magilafuna ona viaqia ʼinaya.
Tauna ena ʼoine luveifana ʼinega tomotau venumedi,
ta ʼeguma vedi ʼaidegana ʼinega venumedi,
e ʼinega omiʼa vedi magilafuna ʼinega ona venumea.
ta ena qaiawa adi ʼetofwafwa ʼinega
ana veʼia ona neia visiqa be wese nuavita ʼidiega.
Mana taunega ena gagaha ʼinega vonaya,
ta wese ge taha tuta ʼinaya
ʼInega taha ʼaubena ʼinaya vita taha taha
ina luveafei ina ʼifoqe ʼidewani dou be,
botana ta wese ʼaiwe ʼalaʼalaina naʼalaia.
vavine nana naluvinea ta ana veʼia naneia.”

content: “Ta bwaʼobwaʼo ana toluvine qiduqiduadi taudi vavine nana maega niʼa ivelamoʼeno kavokavovo ta wese iqaiawa kavokavovo ena kaikaiwabu weaqidi, e taudi ʼabaga nana weaqina ina duvoyavoya be ina dou mana niʼa ʼalaʼalaia ta ʼauna vanevane iʼitea.
Ta toluvine diavona me edi mwaniniva tufwana luluvaia ina tovolo ina ʼitea, ta ina vonaya,

content.text: Babiloni ana luvine lukwayavonega niʼa lobea!’

content: “Ta wese bwaʼobwaʼo ana tovegimwaneavo ʼabaga nana weaqina ina nuavita ta ina dou, mana ge taha toga wese datoatoa be edi kulufa nagimwanedi,

ʼedewani goula be, siliba be, dabo kaikaiwabudi be, bagi be, mwali be, kaleko sulu wadawadaeadi be, kaleko sulu kaikaiwabudi qimwaqimwalidi ta bweabweala otaqidi be, ʼaiwe meiladi aqiaqina be, dona qiduqiduadi be, dabo wadawadaeadi be, ʼaiwe adi maisa ʼenaʼina be, kainumu kofa ta ʼaeani be wese vaina kainumu namanamalidi.

Ta wese vane ʼidewani kemwata be, dedemusi be, keninitu be, kedimona be, dedeʼwa meiladi aqiaqina ʼidewani inisenisi be mulo be, ʼau meilana aqiaqina be, dedeʼwa ʼaiwe olibe vuaqina ʼinega be, ʼoine be, falawa witi be, bulumakau be, sifi be, osi be, waga lihilihi, ta wese edi tofewa kavovo ge taha toga nagimwanedi. Vonahaqiaqi, tovegimwane diavona tomotau ikafidi ta ʼabibodanaya ivegimwaneyedi tovekaikaiwabu ʼidia.

“ʼInega tovegimwane diavona ina gaba ʼabaga nana ʼinaya ina vonaya, Yani qabuna adi ʼita aqiaqi otaqidi eu ʼebenuaʼewa niʼa iawala. Ta kulufa kaikaiwabudi uawatubo aqiaqiedi ge wese una ʼita ʼeviviedi.

Vonahaqiaqi, tovegimwane diavona edi kaikaiwabu qiduana ʼabaga nana ʼinega niʼa ilobedi, e taudi me edi mwaniniva ina tovolo luluvaiega ta ʼabaga nana ana luvematasabu waiwaina ina ʼitea. Ta me edi dou be wese me edi duvoyavoya ina vonaya,

content.text: ta lukwayavonega eu kaikaiwabu diavona iawala.’

content: “Ta wese toniwaga be, waga ana tofewayavo be, togelu ta wese tomeqabu edi toa weaqina mane ilobelobedi edi fewa ʼinega mwadeʼwaya, e baʼe qabu diavona luluvaiega ina tovolo,
ta ʼabaga nana ʼauna ina ʼitea ta ina ʼalabwau ina vonaya, ‘Lova ge taha ʼabaga ana ʼita aqiaqi otaqina omoʼe ʼabaga nana ʼidewani, ta baʼitagana maʼoda?’
ʼInega edi nuavita ʼinega ʼunuʼunudi ʼinaya bwaʼobwaʼo fwayana ina aʼuya be ina dou qiduana ta ina vonaya,

content.text: ʼAbaga qiduana veilaqe gegoyo niʼa lobea!
be ena tovaletuyanayavo qabumi ona qaiawa,
mana lova visiqa ʼabaga nana ʼinega olobea,
ta baʼitagana ena veilivu veifa ʼimia

content: ʼInega Yaubada ena tovaleʼewa waiwaina taha dabo qidua vaʼinena silagaia inoqei webui mwadeʼwaya ta vonaya,

content.text: be ge wese taha toga naʼita ʼevivieu.
mana ge taha wese ʼevosi nage ʼebelaha
ʼidewani afi be, loli be, sagali
ta wese bea ana muʼe naʼifoqe ʼiuyega.
Ta ge taha tuta wese odamu
Ta wese gebu tovaqi mevavinedi be meʼolotodi
ta wese eu luʼafoʼa ʼinega diʼwe qabudi
taudi ena nuanua isimana ʼifoqeyedi uluveʼaligidi
ta sulalidi inoqa eu ʼedayavo ʼidia.
